title: Proxmox VE
description: Are the Proxmox nodes overcommitted, are the guests that should run running, and how is storage filling?

panels.title: Nodes online
panels.description: Proxmox VE nodes the API reports as online. A node that's down still counts in the total of the Nodes table, with CPU and memory empty.

targets.expr: sum(pve_up{id=~"node/($node)"})

panels.title: Quorum
panels.description: Whether the cluster has quorum: more than half of its votes (one per node, plus the QDevice's) present. Without it, the cluster's configuration is read-only: guests can't be started, migrated or changed. In a two-node cluster, one node going down loses quorum unless a QDevice casts the deciding vote. Each node is asked for its own view, and the worst one counts. Empty when the nodes aren't in a cluster.

targets.expr: min(pve_up{job="pve_quorum", id=~"cluster/.+"})

panels.title: QDevice
panels.description: Whether the cluster's QDevice (an external tie-breaker vote, corosync-qnetd) is connected; each node is asked, and the worst view counts. Empty when no QDevice is configured.

targets.expr: min(pve_qdevice_up{job="pve_quorum"})

panels.title: Running guests
panels.description: Running VMs and containers (templates don't count).

targets.expr: count(pve_up * on (instance, id) group_left pve_guest_info{node=~"$node", template!="1"} == 1)

panels.title: Down, start at boot
panels.description: VMs and containers set to start at boot that aren't running. Usually a guest that failed to start, or was stopped by hand and not started again.

targets.expr: count((pve_up == 0) * on (instance, id) group_left (node) pve_guest_info{node=~"$node", template!="1"} and on (node, id) pve_onboot_status == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Memory committed
panels.description: Memory allocated to running guests as a share of the node's memory, on the most committed node. Orange from 90 %, red from 100 %: guests could then use more than the node has.

targets.expr: max(sum by (node) (pve_memory_size_bytes * on (instance, id) pve_up * on (instance, id) group_left (node) pve_guest_info{node=~"$node", template!="1"}) / on (node) max by (node) (label_replace(pve_memory_size_bytes{id=~"node/($node)"}, "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)")))

panels.title: vCPU : CPU
panels.description: vCPUs of running guests per logical CPU, on the most overcommitted node. Above 1 is normal for light guests; above 3 or so, busy guests wait for CPU time.

targets.expr: max(sum by (node) (pve_cpu_usage_limit * on (instance, id) pve_up * on (instance, id) group_left (node) pve_guest_info{node=~"$node", template!="1"}) / on (node) max by (node) (label_replace(pve_cpu_usage_limit{id=~"node/($node)"}, "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)")))

panels.title: Fullest storage
panels.description: Space used on the fullest storage of the selected nodes (shared storage, such as a NAS, included). Orange from 80 %, red from 90 %.

targets.expr: max(pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"storage/($node)/.+"} / (pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/($node)/.+"} > 0))

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Each Proxmox VE node; one that is offline keeps its row with CPU and memory empty. Memory committed: memory allocated to running guests over the node's memory. vCPU : CPU: vCPUs of running guests per logical CPU.

targets.expr: 100 * max by (node) (label_replace(pve_cpu_usage_ratio{id=~"node/($node)"}, "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)"))
max by (node) (label_replace(pve_cpu_usage_limit{id=~"node/($node)"}, "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)"))

100 * max by (node) (label_replace(pve_memory_usage_bytes{id=~"node/($node)"}, "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)")) / max by (node) (label_replace(pve_memory_size_bytes{id=~"node/($node)"}, "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)"))
max by (node) (label_replace(pve_memory_size_bytes{id=~"node/($node)"}, "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)"))

sum by (node) (pve_memory_size_bytes * on (instance, id) pve_up * on (instance, id) group_left (node) pve_guest_info{node=~"$node", template!="1"}) / on (node) max by (node) (label_replace(pve_memory_size_bytes{id=~"node/($node)"}, "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)"))

sum by (node) (pve_cpu_usage_limit * on (instance, id) pve_up * on (instance, id) group_left (node) pve_guest_info{node=~"$node", template!="1"}) / on (node) max by (node) (label_replace(pve_cpu_usage_limit{id=~"node/($node)"}, "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)"))
count by (node) (pve_up * on (instance, id) group_left (node) pve_guest_info{node=~"$node", template!="1"} == 1)
max by (node) (label_replace(pve_uptime_seconds{id=~"node/($node)"}, "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)"))
max by (node) (label_replace(pve_up{id=~"node/($node)"}, "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)"))
100 * max by (node) (label_replace(pve_cpu_usage_ratio{id=~"node/($node)"}, "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)"))

panels.title: Node memory
panels.description: Memory used on each node, and memory allocated to its running guests (committed) — both as a share of the node's memory.

targets.expr: 100 * max by (node) (label_replace(pve_memory_usage_bytes{id=~"node/($node)"}, "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)")) / max by (node) (label_replace(pve_memory_size_bytes{id=~"node/($node)"}, "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)"))

100 * (sum by (node) (pve_memory_size_bytes * on (instance, id) pve_up * on (instance, id) group_left (node) pve_guest_info{node=~"$node", template!="1"}) / on (node) max by (node) (label_replace(pve_memory_size_bytes{id=~"node/($node)"}, "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)")))

panels.title: Storage
panels.description: Every storage of the selected nodes. Shared storage (NFS, for example) appears once per node. Full in: at the last week's growth rate.

targets.expr: max by (id, node, storage, plugintype, content) (pve_disk_size_bytes * on (instance, id) group_left (node, storage, plugintype, content) pve_storage_info{node=~"$node"})
max by (id) (pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"storage/($node)/.+"})
100 * max by (id) (pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"storage/($node)/.+"}) / max by (id) (pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/($node)/.+"} > 0)

max by (id) ((pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/($node)/.+"} > 0) - pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"storage/($node)/.+"}) / clamp_min(max by (id) (deriv(pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"storage/($node)/.+"}[7d])), 0.001) / 86400
max by (id) (pve_storage_shared{id=~"storage/($node)/.+"})
max by (id) (pve_up{id=~"storage/($node)/.+"})
100 * max by (node, storage) ((pve_disk_usage_bytes / (pve_disk_size_bytes > 0)) * on (instance, id) group_left (node, storage) pve_storage_info{node=~"$node"})

panels.title: Guests
panels.description: Every VM and container (not templates). CPU: share of the guest's own vCPUs. VM memory comes from the balloon driver or guest agent; without them Proxmox reports what the VM process holds. Disk: the size of the boot disk (containers: their root disk).

targets.expr: max by (key, id, name, node, type) (label_join(pve_up * on (instance, id) group_left (name, node, type) pve_guest_info{node=~"$node", template!="1"}, "key", "/", "node", "id"))
max by (key) (label_join(pve_cpu_usage_limit * on (instance, id) group_left (node) pve_guest_info{node=~"$node", template!="1"}, "key", "/", "node", "id"))
100 * max by (key) (label_join(pve_cpu_usage_ratio * on (instance, id) group_left (node) pve_guest_info{node=~"$node", template!="1"}, "key", "/", "node", "id"))
max by (key) (label_join(pve_memory_usage_bytes * on (instance, id) group_left (node) pve_guest_info{node=~"$node", template!="1"}, "key", "/", "node", "id"))
max by (key) (label_join(pve_memory_size_bytes * on (instance, id) group_left (node) pve_guest_info{node=~"$node", template!="1"}, "key", "/", "node", "id"))
max by (key) (label_join(pve_disk_size_bytes * on (instance, id) group_left (node) pve_guest_info{node=~"$node", template!="1"}, "key", "/", "node", "id"))
max by (key) (label_join((pve_uptime_seconds > 0) * on (instance, id) group_left (node) pve_guest_info{node=~"$node", template!="1"}, "key", "/", "node", "id"))
max by (key) (label_join(pve_onboot_status * on (node, id) group_left pve_guest_info{node=~"$node", template!="1"}, "key", "/", "node", "id"))

panels.title: Guest CPU (top 10)
panels.description: CPU cores each guest is using (CPU share × its vCPUs), so guests of different sizes compare.

targets.expr: topk(10, max by (name) (pve_cpu_usage_ratio * on (instance, id) pve_cpu_usage_limit * on (instance, id) group_left (name) pve_guest_info{node=~"$node", template!="1"}))
topk(10, max by (name) (pve_memory_usage_bytes * on (instance, id) group_left (name) pve_guest_info{node=~"$node", template!="1"}))

panels.title: Guest network (top 10)
panels.description: Traffic in and out of each guest, combined.

targets.expr: topk(10, max by (name) ((rate(pve_network_receive_bytes_total[$__rate_interval]) + on (instance, id) rate(pve_network_transmit_bytes_total[$__rate_interval])) * on (instance, id) group_left (name) pve_guest_info{node=~"$node", template!="1"}))

panels.title: Guest disk I/O (top 10)
panels.description: Bytes each guest reads and writes on its disks, combined. Not every storage type reports this.

targets.expr: topk(10, max by (name) ((rate(pve_disk_read_bytes_total[$__rate_interval]) + on (instance, id) rate(pve_disk_written_bytes_total[$__rate_interval])) * on (instance, id) group_left (name) pve_guest_info{node=~"$node", template!="1"}))
